unit.label: -ness
unit.mentor_note: Ness is the plainest abstraction machine in English: attach it to any adjective and you get the quality itself. Half of what a summary question asks is whether you can do this in your head.

members.meaning: decency; the quality of being good
the state of having a large population
an occupation; the state of being busy
the state of being far off or distant

predict_options.text: The condition or quality of being something
A person who performs an action

discovery.understand_note: Ness names the quality itself, cut loose from anything that has it. Notice that business is literally busy-ness, worn down by centuries of use — the suffix is older than it looks.

applies.prompt: Knowing -ness names a quality itself, what does remoteness mean in a sentence like "the remoteness of the argument from the evidence"?

options.text: How far apart the argument and the evidence stand
A place a long way from the city
The difficulty of understanding the argument
